anatomy.root: Direct primitive Root alias owns selected/open and form control; no wrapper DOM.
anatomy.field: Chosen wrapper for native label/help and actual hidden source form input.
anatomy.form-input: Actual Root validation/form input; visually hidden, tabindex=-1, value follows selected serialization.
anatomy.trigger: Real native Button role combobox; public data-size sm/default.
anatomy.form-values: Actual multiple-mode repeated hidden values, distinct from unnamed validation proxy.
anatomy.value: Actual value label output, separate from the field label.
anatomy.trigger-icon: Actual private indicator render SVG itself, not a fabricated extra span wrapper.
anatomy.popup: Actual Popup is presentation because this wrapper inserts List.
anatomy.list: Actual private List owns listbox semantics and trigger aria-controls target.
anatomy.label: Actual GroupLabel, not a field label.
anatomy.item: Actual option; disabled remains focusable but cannot commit.
anatomy.scroll-up: Actual decorative pointer-scroll arrow; name does not promise native Button role.
anatomy.scroll-down: Actual decorative pointer-scroll arrow; rendered/placed by primitive overflow.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: The source Trigger is a Button role combobox, with 32px default/10px corner observed in the native outline Button and 10px popup/4px inset list. Public sm uses an explicit 28px smaller reference role; instance widths 192/256px are not forced. Source Content always inserts a List, so Popup is presentational and the inner List is the actual listbox/aria-controls target; labels remain native field/GroupLabel identities. The Root actual hidden text input is a form/validation proxy, not a second accessible combobox or native select. Default alignItemWithTrigger=true, source collision/scroll-arrow geometry and closing-on-window-resize remain authoritative; fixed mock overlay coordinates are absent. Shared popup surface CSS is explicitly delegated to the common cn-menu-target rule, while option/value/trigger/indicator styles are Select-specific. Source scroll arrows remain decorative pointer affordances rather than invented Buttons. Text/selected arrays, readonly, disabled focusability and independent cancelable value/open transactions retain source behavior; no query input or filtering is invented. Portal direction and theme are supplied on the actual Content element in the adapter.
